This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their hulking frames, hunched posture, [[Color|pink]], purple, and tan skin, long tan fur, and protruding brow.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species was present on the planet [[Kijimi]] shortly before its destruction.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Hulking-Furry-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 22 by Louis Wiltshire]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> They were designed by [[Louis Wiltshire]],<ref name="Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> with inspiration from [[Neal Scanlan]], who wanted to create a "Ludo-like" creature, Ludo being a character from the [[1986]] film [[Wikipedia:Labyrinth (1986 film)|''Labyrinth]], directed by [[Wikipedia:Jim Henson|Jim Henson]] and produced by [[George Lucas]]. Though Scanlan stated in an interview with [[Wikipedia:Yahoo|Yahoo Entertainment]] that he did not believe the species made it into the final cut of the film, it does actually appear briefly in the bar in [[Kijimi City]].<ref name="Yahoo Entertainment">{{WebCite|url=https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/star-wars-jim-henson-tribute-cut-from-rise-of-skywalker-194002759.html|text=Here's the stealth 'Star Wars' tribute to Jim Henson that was cut from 'The Rise of Skywalker'|author=Ethan Alter|work=[https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment Yahoo Entertainment]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/vlIoi}}</ref> The species was referred to by the production code "Wizard 22" on set.<ref name="Art Book" />
